input.quote: Client hereby grants to TrueLink the nonexclusive worldwide right and license to use, distribute, disseminate, license, resell, exploit, upload, display, copy and store Credit Data subject to the limitations set forth in and in accordance with the Non-Competition Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 2(d) confirms only TrueLink's ownership; nothing confirms that Client owns its borrower/applicant data or the work product of the Support Services, while the TrueLink Intellectual Property definition sweeps in everything "associated with the Interface" (including customizations we pay for) and Section 8(d) grants TrueLink a worldwide right to resell and exploit our borrowers' Credit Data. We added a Client data/work-product ownership sentence with a licence-back of embedded TrueLink IP and a no-joint-ownership statement; TrueLink keeps the Interface.

input.quote: a. Grant. TrueLink hereby grants to Client a non-exclusive license to use the Interface in the ordinary course of its business of the origination, underwriting, processing and funding of consumer finance receivables in accordance with this Agreement.
input.rationale: The grant runs to Client only — affiliates and the correspondent brokers/contractors contemplated by the recitals are not covered (and Section 8(c) limits access to Client's own officers, employees and agents), there is no successor transferability, and Section 13 terminates the licence "promptly" on certain Client breaches with no cure period. We extended the grant to affiliates and contractors, added successor transfer, and limited revocation to termination under the Agreement.
